verdict.rationale: Phoenix ships an official CLI (`@arizeai/phoenix-cli`) for setup/tracing and also supports `uvx arize-phoenix serve` and terminal-based deployment, showing genuine CLI tooling exists. However, the evidence only documents a narrow setup/serve use case, not a broad CLI covering datasets, evals, prompts, etc., which are otherwise SDK/UI-driven. missing for 10: full CLI command reference/docs covering more than setup and serve, independent hands-on verification of CLI usage.
